label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
Hiya Beth,

Just you on this, I haven't replied to the group and I'm not going to. I've just landed off a Lagos and my head's mush, so forgive me if this rambles.

I'm not going to tell you what to do about Lowri. I was there in November, I know things got said on both sides, and I'm not picking between you. For what it's worth, I think she's sorrier than that email makes her sound. She's as stubborn as you are, and I say that with love to the pair of you. But that's between you and her, and it can wait.

It's Nia I'm thinking about. She rang me last week in tears asking if you were still coming. She doesn't know you've pulled out and I haven't said a word. You're the one who sat with her in the Heath every night when her mam was bad. You're doing a reading at Margam on the 17th of April. She wants you at her hen, Beth, and I think you'd be gutted afterwards if you weren't there.

So here's a thought. Skip the cottage on Friday, skip the paddleboarding, and just come for the meal on Saturday. You only need to be in Tenby for 6. The train from Cardiff Central is about two and a half hours, I'll pick you up from the station, and you can kip in with me that night as I've got the twin room. You wouldn't have to be on your own with Lowri for a minute.

Selfishly, I want you there too. I swapped my Orlando with Kerry to get that weekend off and lost a night stop I really wanted, so the least I'm owed is you sat next to me with a glass of wine.

Hold off sending Lowri the £85 for now. If you're only coming Saturday it'll want working out differently anyway, so leave it till you've decided.

No rush to answer. Have a think, and ring me if you'd rather talk it through.

Love you,
Siân x

reasons: It omits that the Heath support was in 2019, that the row was at Lowri's 40th, and that Nia will remember Bethan's absence.
